messages.content: Who is the best singer in Jazz

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

top.description: Number of top players to return. Default is 5.

message.content: The title of “best” jazz vocalist can vary depending on personal taste and criteria (technical skill, influence, innovation). Many consider Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Sarah Vaughan, and later artists like Diana Krall or Cécile Béatrice as among the greatest. Historically, Ella Fitzgerald’s impeccable technique and improvisational mastery earned her the nickname “Queen of Swing.” However, if you’re looking for a definitive list of top performers, I can use the `search_music_instrument_players` function to find the most celebrated singers in jazz. Let me know if you'd like me to do that!
